data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella yacht charter vegan catering 2030 experience? You’re in the right place. As the Costa del Sol embraces plant-based dining, our fleet of 18 boats offers fully customisable vegan menus—from tapas to paella—ensuring your day on the Mediterranean is both sustainable and delicious. All charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella Marina, or Cabopino, and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. Whether you’re celebrating a birthday or just escaping the Golden Mile, we’ve got your vegan needs covered.

Why Choose a Vegan Catering Yacht Charter in Marbella?

Marbella’s culinary scene has evolved, and so has our charter service. Vegan catering isn’t an afterthought—it’s a priority. From the moment you step aboard your chosen boat, you’ll enjoy plant-based snacks like hummus, vegetable crudités, olives, and fresh fruit, all included in the standard package. For a more elaborate feast, we can arrange vegan paella, grilled vegetables, or gourmet tapas. The Mediterranean waters off Marbella, Estepona, and Sotogrande provide the perfect backdrop for a guilt-free feast.

Our Vegan-Friendly Fleet

Every boat in our fleet can accommodate vegan catering. Here’s a quick overview of options:

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are perfect for an intimate vegan sunset cruise. Larger parties will love the space on the Mangusta 80 (12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax). All depart from Puerto Banús.

Sample Vegan Menus for Your Charter

Our caterers specialise in fresh, local produce. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Starter: Vegan tapas—patatas bravas with aioli, marinated olives, and roasted red peppers.
  • Main: Vegan paella with artichokes, peas, and saffron, or a grilled vegetable platter with quinoa salad.
  • Dessert: Fresh fruit skewers or vegan chocolate mousse.
  • Drinks: All standard drinks are vegan-friendly; add vegan red wine or sparkling water on request.

Custom menus are arranged via WhatsApp, so you can tailor every course to your taste.

Top Vegan-Friendly Destinations on the Costa del Sol

Your charter can explore the best of the coast. Popular stops include:

  • Cala del Faro – A quiet cove near Marbella, perfect for a vegan picnic.
  • Cala Cortés – Crystal-clear waters ideal for swimming and snorkelling.
  • Estepona – Anchor near the marina and enjoy a vegan lunch at a beachfront restaurant.
  • Cabopino – A serene spot with a nudist beach and vegan-friendly chiringuitos.

Your skipper will recommend the best route based on weather and your preferences.

How to Book a Vegan Yacht Charter in Marbella

Booking is simple. Choose your boat from our fleet, then contact us via WhatsApp to discuss your vegan catering needs. We’ll confirm availability, arrange the menu, and send you a quote. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the price is fixed at €749/2h or €2,299/8h, inclusive of all standard items. For Tier B boats (Mangusta 80), the minimum is €4,719/4h, which includes a free jet ski and vegan menu. All other boats are priced on request.

Don’t wait—2030 is the year to experience the best of Marbella’s vegan yacht charter scene. [Book your vegan charter today](/).
